        ORG #8000
        INCBIN STUFF

        ORG   #A000
        PHASE #2000

        INCLUDE SGEN
        INCLUDE SGEN1_L
        INCLUDE SGEN2_L
        INCLUDE SGEN3
        INCLUDE SGEN4
        INCLUDE SGEN5
        INCLUDE SGEN6
        INCLUDE SGEN7
        INCLUDE SGEN8
___END
        ORG   #BE00
        PHASE #3E00

DIVTAB3 INCBIN  DIVTAB3

        ORG #8000
        UNPHASE
        DI
        LD A,#00
        LD HL,#9100
        LD DE,#9001
        LD BC,#0000
        EXX
        LD DE,#0201
        EXX
        LD LX,#FF
        CALL SGEN
        LD IY,#5C3A
        EXX
        LD HL,#2758
        EXX
        EI
        RET
